BUG-01.title: [BUG-01][Critical] Login exposes stored secrets and passwords are kept in plaintext
BUG-01.body:
## Summary
The authentication implementation stores passwords in plaintext and the login response includes sensitive user fields such as `password`, `reset_token`, and `locked_until`.

## Environment
- EShop local SUT at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`
- Official Newman execution: 2026-08-22
- Evidence cases: `R-H-05`, `R-H-06`

## Steps to reproduce
1. Register a test account.
2. Log in using the valid credentials.
3. Inspect the returned user object and the persisted user record.

## Expected
Passwords are stored only as secure hashes, and authentication responses never disclose password/reset/lock internals.

## Actual
The password is stored as plaintext and sensitive internal fields are returned by login.

## Evidence
![BUG-01 evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z3nz3nn/HW06-software-testing/main/evidence/screenshots/bug-01-login-secret-leak.jpg)

Official compact execution ledger: `evidence/newman/execution-summary.json`.

BUG-02.title: [BUG-02][High] Password reset accepts weak, empty, null, missing, and numeric passwords
BUG-02.body:
## Summary
`POST /api/reset-password` does not enforce the FR-01 password-complexity rule.

## Environment
- EShop local SUT at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`
- Official Newman execution: 2026-08-22
- Evidence cases: `R-AI-05..10`, `R-AI-35..38`

## Steps to reproduce
1. Obtain an active reset token for a test user.
2. Call the endpoint with weak, empty, null, missing, or numeric `newPassword` variants.
3. Attempt login with the supplied value where applicable.

## Expected
The endpoint rejects values that do not satisfy FR-01 and preserves the existing password.

## Actual
The endpoint accepts multiple invalid password variants and changes the credential state.

## Evidence
![BUG-02 evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z3nz3nn/HW06-software-testing/main/evidence/screenshots/bug-02-reset-password-complexity.jpg)

Official compact execution ledger: `evidence/newman/execution-summary.json`.

BUG-03.title: [BUG-03][High] Reset token has only four digits and no expiry timestamp
BUG-03.body:
## Summary
The forgot-password flow generates a four-digit reset token and persists no expiration timestamp, so the SEC-07 six-digit/expiry requirements cannot be enforced.

## Environment
- EShop local SUT at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`
- Evidence case: `R-AI-15` plus source-backed root-cause review

## Steps to reproduce
1. Request a reset token for an existing user.
2. Inspect the token shape and user reset state.
3. Check whether an expiry value is stored or validated.

## Expected
A six-digit token is generated and bound to an enforceable expiry.

## Actual
The token contains four digits and no expiry timestamp exists.

## Evidence
![BUG-03 evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z3nz3nn/HW06-software-testing/main/evidence/screenshots/bug-03-weak-reset-token.jpg)

Official compact execution ledger: `evidence/newman/execution-summary.json`.

BUG-04.title: [BUG-04][Critical] Apply-coupon lacks JWT authorization and trusts body user_id
BUG-04.body:
## Summary
`POST /api/apply-coupon` has no JWT gate and uses the caller-supplied `user_id`, enabling identity substitution and usage-limit bypass.

## Environment
- EShop local SUT at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`
- Official Newman execution: 2026-08-22
- Evidence cases: `C-AI-02..06`, `C-AI-08..09`

## Steps to reproduce
1. Call apply-coupon without a bearer token or with an invalid token.
2. Set `user_id` to another known user.
3. Observe that the discount is still calculated against the supplied identity.

## Expected
A valid JWT is required and the effective user identity is derived from the authenticated principal.

## Actual
Requests are processed without valid authentication and body identity is trusted.

## Evidence
![BUG-04 evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z3nz3nn/HW06-software-testing/main/evidence/screenshots/bug-04-coupon-missing-auth.jpg)

Official compact execution ledger: `evidence/newman/execution-summary.json`.

BUG-05.title: [BUG-05][High] Percentage coupon formula produces negative discounts and inflated totals
BUG-05.body:
## Summary
The percentage-coupon calculation uses `total × (1 - discount_value)` instead of the specified percentage formula.

## Environment
- EShop local SUT at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`
- Official Newman execution: 2026-08-22
- Evidence cases: `C-AI-01`, `C-AI-19`, `C-AI-34`

## Steps to reproduce
1. Apply a valid percentage coupon such as SAVE10 to an eligible total.
2. Compare `discount_amount` and `final_amount` with the FR-09 formula.

## Expected
`discount_amount = total × discount_value / 100`, capped if required, and `final_amount = total - discount_amount`.

## Actual
The calculation can produce a negative discount and a final amount greater than the original total.

## Evidence
![BUG-05 evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z3nz3nn/HW06-software-testing/main/evidence/screenshots/bug-05-coupon-percentage-formula.jpg)

Official compact execution ledger: `evidence/newman/execution-summary.json`.

BUG-06.title: [BUG-06][Medium] Coupon rejects an order exactly equal to minimum threshold
BUG-06.body:
## Summary
The minimum-order boundary uses a strict greater-than comparison and rejects an order exactly equal to `min_order_value`.

## Environment
- EShop local SUT at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`
- Official Newman execution: 2026-08-22
- Evidence cases: `C-AI-18`, `C-AI-21`, `C-AI-22`

## Steps to reproduce
1. Seed/choose an active coupon with a known minimum order value.
2. Apply it to a total exactly equal to that minimum.

## Expected
The coupon applies because the total satisfies the inclusive minimum boundary.

## Actual
The endpoint rejects the exact-threshold order.

## Evidence
![BUG-06 evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z3nz3nn/HW06-software-testing/main/evidence/screenshots/bug-06-coupon-threshold-boundary.jpg)

Official compact execution ledger: `evidence/newman/execution-summary.json`.

BUG-07.title: [BUG-07][Critical] Normal users can call the admin product-import endpoint
BUG-07.body:
## Summary
`POST /api/admin/import-products` validates a JWT but does not enforce `role=admin`.

## Environment
- EShop local SUT at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`
- Official Newman execution: 2026-08-22
- Evidence cases: `I-AI-02`, `I-AI-56`

## Steps to reproduce
1. Log in as a non-admin user.
2. Send a valid product batch with that user's bearer token to the admin import endpoint.
3. Inspect response and database state.

## Expected
The endpoint returns an authorization error and makes no database changes.

## Actual
The normal user is allowed to import products.

## Evidence
![BUG-07 evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z3nz3nn/HW06-software-testing/main/evidence/screenshots/bug-07-import-missing-role-check.jpg)

Official compact execution ledger: `evidence/newman/execution-summary.json`.

BUG-08.title: [BUG-08][High] Product import omits required row-field validation
BUG-08.body:
## Summary
Import validation checks little beyond a truthy product name; invalid prices, categories, and name lengths can be inserted.

## Environment
- EShop local SUT at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`
- Official Newman execution: 2026-08-22
- Evidence cases: `I-AI-21..33`, `I-H-04`

## Steps to reproduce
1. Authenticate as admin.
2. Import rows containing negative/non-numeric prices, invalid/missing categories, or out-of-range names.
3. Query products after the request.

## Expected
The batch is rejected under FR-12/FR-16 validation rules and invalid rows are not persisted.

## Actual
Multiple invalid field variants are inserted.

## Evidence
![BUG-08 evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z3nz3nn/HW06-software-testing/main/evidence/screenshots/bug-08-import-incomplete-validation.jpg)

Official compact execution ledger: `evidence/newman/execution-summary.json`.

BUG-09.title: [BUG-09][High] Mixed-invalid import batch partially commits instead of rolling back
BUG-09.body:
## Summary
A batch containing valid and invalid products is not atomic: valid rows can persist even though the batch should roll back.

## Environment
- EShop local SUT at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`
- Official Newman execution: 2026-08-22
- Evidence cases: `I-AI-40..42`, `I-AI-51`, `I-H-01`

## Steps to reproduce
1. Authenticate as admin and record the pre-state.
2. Submit a batch with at least one valid and one invalid row.
3. Compare database state after the response.

## Expected
The transaction rejects the batch and rolls back every row.

## Actual
One or more valid rows remain committed after the invalid batch.

## Evidence
![BUG-09 evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z3nz3nn/HW06-software-testing/main/evidence/screenshots/bug-09-import-non-atomic.jpg)

Official compact execution ledger: `evidence/newman/execution-summary.json`.

BUG-10.title: [BUG-10][Medium] Malformed input exposes Express and Node stack details
BUG-10.body:
## Summary
Malformed JSON/null-row handling exposes framework stack traces and internal paths instead of a sanitized error.

## Environment
- EShop local SUT at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`
- Official Newman execution: 2026-08-22
- Evidence cases: `R-AI-40`, `C-AI-40`, `I-AI-45`, `I-H-01`

## Steps to reproduce
1. Send malformed JSON or a null product row to the affected endpoint.
2. Inspect the response body.

## Expected
A stable client error is returned without stack, SQL, filesystem, or framework internals.

## Actual
The response discloses Express/Node stack details and local internal paths.

## Evidence
![BUG-10 evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z3nz3nn/HW06-software-testing/main/evidence/screenshots/bug-10-stack-leak.jpg)

Official compact execution ledger: `evidence/newman/execution-summary.json`.
